The healthcare workforce education capacity chokepoint appears to include clinical placement administration, simulation substitution, credentialing/compliance workflows, program approvals, and employer-linked clinical pathways, not just enrollment demand.

node: Healthcare workforce education capacity: nursing, behavioral health, counseling, social work, occupational therapy, and licensure programs
summary: Layer 1B expands the healthcare workforce education capacity node into a two-lane universe. Reference anchors are scaled healthcare-education operators that directly add nursing, counseling, behavioral-health, social-work, OT/OTA, and medical seats. The underfollowed lane focuses on suppliers that can relieve the harder chokepoints: clinical rotation administration, compliance training, credentialing, and simulation-based education infrastructure. The highest-fit underfollowed names found in this pass are HealthStream, for clinical-rotation and healthcare workforce software, and CAE, for simulation equipment and digital medical education used by nursing schools and healthcare training programs. No buy/sell view is implied.
